findings.label: Sentiment enum mismatch risk
findings.description: The hardcoded sentiment values in JournalSearch (happy, sad, calm, stressed, neutral) must match the backend's accepted sentiment list. If the backend uses different values or accepts a superset, validation will fail silently or the server will reject requests with 400.

findings.label: Type-unsafe parameter discrimination
findings.description: The isAdvanced flag in AdvancedSearchParams is a workaround. TypeScript discriminated unions would provide better type safety and prevent accidental mixing of param types.

findings.label: Missing analysis content check edge case
findings.description: AdvancedSearchAnalysis only renders if analysis exists and has content, but silently skips render if all fields are empty. If AI returns an empty analysis object, the user receives no indication that AI was requested but returned no results.
